t: The LAP twin 2ft LED batten is a robust and efficient lighting solution, providing powerful daylight illumination for various professional settings. This 600mm LED batten is ideal for workshops, garages, and commercial spaces requiring reliable and bright lighting, including outdoor installations. Its durable polycarbonate construction and anti-corrosive fitting ensure long-term performance. Twin rows of integrated LEDs deliver a high 3000 lumen output with 25W energy consumption. An IP65 rating makes this outdoor LED batten suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, offering protection against dust and water jets. Installation is straightforward with a 1m pre-fitted cable and included brackets for ceiling or wall mounting.
